title: Freight GHG emissions report
statement: Calculated with Sootcase following the GLEC Framework v3.3 and ISO 14083:2023 methodology. Conformity with ISO 14083 is not declared by this report.
reference: Per-shipment results with factors, sources and distances: Sootcase batch output for the same input. Method: https://github.com/majidkabir/sootcase

failures.error: line 7: weight_kg: "abc" is not a number

failure_reasons.reason: line #: weight_kg: "abc" is not a number

default_sources.source: GLEC Framework v3.3 (Smart Freight Centre, 2026), Section 3 Module 2, Table 1, air: aircraft type unknown, short-haul (< 1500 km), including the +95 km DAF, for use with the great circle distance

GLEC Framework v3.3 (Smart Freight Centre, 2026), Section 3 Module 2, Table 3, logistics hubs (GILA project: Fraunhofer IML, Politecnico di Milano, GreenRouter; median values): warehouse, ambient (n = 92)

GLEC Framework v3.3 (Smart Freight Centre, 2026), Section 3 Module 2, Europe and South America road, Table 8: rigid truck 26-32 t GVW, average/mixed load, diesel; includes GLEC's +5% distance conversion, so it is per shortest feasible distance

GLEC Framework v3.3 (Smart Freight Centre, 2026), Section 3 Module 2, rail, Europe: EU average where the traction is unknown, 18.4 g CO2e/t-km WTW (p. 98, based on 62% of EU track being electrified); the TTW/WTT split weights GLEC's Table 4 diesel and Table 5 electric average/mixed values 38% / 62%; per shortest feasible distance (GLEC Section 1 Chapter 4, Rail, p. 46)

GLEC Framework v3.3 (Smart Freight Centre, 2026), Section 3 Module 2, Tables 18-19, container vessels (Clean Cargo trade lane factors, reporting year 2025): industry average (origin-destination pair unknown), dry, 13 + 60.4 g CO2e/TEU-km (WTT + TTW) / 10 t per TEU (GLEC's average when the cargo mass is not known); includes GLEC's +15% distance conversion, so it is per shortest feasible distance

notes: 1 of 4 shipments could not be calculated and are excluded from all totals (BAD). Reasons: 1 × line #: weight_kg: "abc" is not a number.

Hub emissions are reported well-to-wheel only: the hub factors used carry no split into operational and energy provision emissions. Operational (TTW) and energy provision (WTT) totals therefore cover transport only.
For 87.9% of tonne-km the type of distance was not stated (distances given without distance_type).
Tonne-km combine more than one type of distance; see the shares per mode.
Default emission intensities are used where no primary data (measured fuel or operation category values) was supplied for a leg or hub; their sources are listed.
